sections.title: Personal Lines Insurance (Allstate)
sections.description: Allstate (Northbrook IL HQ) is one of the US's largest personal lines insurers, with 16+ million household customers across auto, home, and life.

blocks.heading: Auto insurance pricing ML
paragraphs: Allstate's telematics program (Drivewise) creates ML for usage-based insurance pricing — predicting individual driver accident probability from smartphone telematics (acceleration patterns, braking, time of day driving) and translating behavioral risk signals into actuarially sound pricing within Illinois DOI regulatory constraints. Illinois's complex auto insurance regulations create specific model design requirements for Allstate's pricing programs.

blocks.heading: Claims severity and fraud prediction
paragraphs: ML for Allstate's large auto and property claims portfolio — predicting which claims will develop into large losses, identifying potential fraud patterns early in the claims process, and optimizing claims resource allocation for Allstate's enormous claims organization.

blocks.heading: Catastrophe claims triage
paragraphs: ML for Allstate's post-catastrophe claims response — prioritizing outreach to policyholders in the most severely impacted areas, predicting total event loss from early claim reports, and optimizing field adjuster deployment after major storms.

sections.title: Commercial Lines and Specialty Insurance (Zurich and CNA)
sections.description: Zurich North America (Schaumburg) and CNA Financial (Chicago) — both major commercial insurance providers.

blocks.heading: Commercial property underwriting AI
paragraphs: ML for commercial property risk assessment for Chicago's large commercial real estate and industrial insurance market — incorporating building characteristics, occupancy class, fire protection, and the specific natural hazard exposures of the Chicago geography.

blocks.heading: Workers' compensation predictive analytics
paragraphs: ML for workers' compensation claims outcome prediction — identifying claims likely to become high-cost complex cases for early intervention, predicting return-to-work timelines, and optimizing medical management for Zurich's and CNA's large workers' compensation portfolios.

blocks.heading: Management liability underwriting
paragraphs: ML for D&O, EPLI, and cyber insurance underwriting at CNA and Zurich — the specialty lines where quantitative risk factors are harder to identify than in property and casualty but where ML is producing measurable underwriting improvement.

sections.title: Specialty Personal Auto (Kemper)
sections.description: Kemper Corporation (Chicago HQ) specializes in insuring non-standard auto risks — drivers that preferred carriers decline.

blocks.heading: Non-standard auto risk stratification
paragraphs: ML for Kemper's non-standard auto underwriting — identifying which drivers within the non-standard segment represent acceptable risks vs. unacceptable adverse selection for Kemper's specific underwriting appetite.

blocks.heading: Multi-state rate adequacy analytics
paragraphs: ML for Kemper's rate adequacy across its complex multi-state, multi-company regulatory footprint — predicting loss ratios by state and coverage tier for Kemper's rate filing strategy.

sections.title: Agricultural and Farm Insurance
sections.description: Illinois is one of the US's most significant agricultural states — the large farm insurance market creates specific ML demand.

blocks.heading: Crop yield insurance analytics
paragraphs: ML for multi-peril crop insurance (MPCI) underwriting calibration — predicting corn and soybean yield losses from weather data, soil quality, and historical claim patterns for the major agricultural insurance carriers operating in Illinois.

blocks.heading: Farm property underwriting
paragraphs: ML for farmstead and agricultural building underwriting — incorporating the specific fire risk factors of grain storage, the catastrophe exposure from Illinois tornadoes, and the machinery and equipment values of modern large-scale farming operations.

sections.title: Illinois insurance AI regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for insurance AI development in Illinois.

blocks.heading: Illinois Department of Insurance (DOI)
paragraphs: Illinois's insurance commissioner has been active in AI regulation guidance — the Illinois DOI has issued guidance on the use of external data and AI in insurance underwriting that ClickMasters incorporates as design requirements for all Chicago insurance ML.

blocks.heading: BIPA and insurance AI
paragraphs: Illinois's Biometric Information Privacy Act applies to any insurance AI that uses biometric data (including facial recognition for claims processing) — ClickMasters designs all Chicago insurance AI as non-biometric by default.

blocks.heading: Illinois Auto Insurance Law
paragraphs: Illinois's specific auto insurance regulations (mandatory coverages, uninsured motorist requirements) create design constraints for Allstate's and Kemper's pricing and underwriting ML.
